met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over northeast Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood persisted over the same region at 0830 hrs IST of today, the 22nd August, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood persists and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Amritsar, Najibabad, Hardoi, centre of Low Pressure Area over northeast Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood, Jamshedpur, Digha and thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal and extends upto 0.9 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over northeast Assam & neighbourhood extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Myanmar & neighbourhood now lies over north Bay of Bengal off West Bengal-Bangladesh Coasts extending upto 5.8 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. Under its influence, a low pressure area is likely to form over the same region during next 24 hours.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Westcentral & adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal and north Andhra Pradesh – South Odisha coasts at 5.8 km above mean sea level merged with the above cyclonic circulation.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Bay of Bengal & adjoining Bangladesh at 5.8 km above mean sea level merged with the above cyclonic circulation.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Gangetic West Bengal & adjoining Jharkhand at 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
